name: Spare Harmony One, four activities
description: What four of the spare Harmony One's activities send when they start one after the other, from everything off, and what Off sends. No expectations yet: this records the reference for later runs. Keep the remote pointed at the Flirc throughout.

steps.instruction: On the spare Harmony One, press Off and wait until the remote is done, so everything starts from off
On the touch screen, start TV kijken and wait until the remote is done
Start LG kijken and wait until the remote is done
Start Kodi kijken and wait until the remote is done
Start PlayStation 3 and wait until the remote is done
Press Off and wait until the remote is done
